capabilities.name: seed
capabilities.reason: Generate Seed-compatible handoff plans from scientific skill metadata.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record risk classifications, decisions, audit events, and outcomes.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist selected skill, task, input/output paths, and resume state.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record upstream repository, commit, skill path, and source hash.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach generated plans, dry-run reports, and blocked-execution artifacts.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report workflow plan states without hiding state in terminal output.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List assimilated Scientific Agent Skills with optional domain/risk filters.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect a scientific skill's metadata, permissions, provenance, and risk.

commands.name: explain
commands.summary: Explain how a scientific skill maps into AgentOS handoff semantics.

commands.name: prepare
commands.summary: Write a Seed-compatible handoff plan for a scientific skill without executing upstream code.

arguments.description: Generate handoff and audit artifacts without executing upstream scripts.
arguments.name: dry_run

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run a skill only through dry-run or approved low-risk boundaries; otherwise block with an audit artifact.

commands.name: trust-report
commands.summary: Emit the generated trust report for a scientific skill.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check adapter registry integrity and safety defaults.

arguments.description: Generate handoff and audit artifacts without executing upstream scripts.
